-- Update Maine with correct D primary candidates (Costello, Platner, LaFlamme in D primary; Collins uncontested R)
-- Maine rating: Toss-up (Cook), Tilt R (Inside Elections), Toss-up (Sabato)
UPDATE senate_races SET
  candidate1_name = 'TBD — D Primary: Costello, Platner, LaFlamme (RCV)',
  candidate1_party = 'D',
  candidate2_name = 'Susan Collins',
  candidate2_party = 'R',
  status = 'Scheduled',
  primary_date = 'June 9, 2026',
  rating = 'Toss-up',
  notes = 'D primary uses ranked-choice voting. Top candidates: David Costello, Graham Platner, Andrea LaFlamme. Collins uncontested in R primary.'
WHERE state_code = 'ME';

-- Update South Carolina with correct D primary candidates (Andrews, Brown, Freeman)
UPDATE senate_races SET
  candidate1_name = 'TBD — D Primary: Andrews, Brown, Freeman',
  candidate1_party = 'D',
  candidate2_name = 'Lindsey Graham',
  candidate2_party = 'R',
  status = 'Scheduled',
  primary_date = 'June 9, 2026',
  rating = 'Solid R',
  notes = 'D primary candidates: Annie Andrews, Brandon Brown, Kyle Freeman. Graham has R primary challengers (Cowen, Dismukes, Herrmann, Lynch) but is heavily favored. SC has runoff if no candidate gets 50%+ — runoff date June 30.'
WHERE state_code = 'SC';

-- Fix Colorado: Hickenlooper is NOT up in 2026 (won in 2020, serves until 2027)
-- Colorado's 2026 Senate seat is held by Michael Bennet (won in 2022, serves until 2029) — also not up
-- NEITHER Colorado Senate seat is up in 2026 — remove or flag this entry
UPDATE senate_races SET
  notes = 'ERROR: Neither Colorado Senate seat is up in 2026. Hickenlooper serves until Jan 2027 (but won in 2020 for Class 2 — actually up in 2026!). VERIFY.',
  status = 'Scheduled'
WHERE state_code = 'CO';
